subject: Request to substitute an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping

messages.text: We're proposing an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 and want sign-off before we order material. We would like this reviewed before the fixture rough-in gets underway. The substitution may affect the plumbing fixture budget depending on the manufacturer. This substitution will not affect the domestic water pressure test date. Please respond by the end of the week so we can place the order.
